# Frost Giant (`monsters:frost-giant`)
*Huge giant, neutral evil* | **CR** 8 (XP 3,900; PB +3)
**AC** 15 | **HP** 149 (13d12 + 65) | **Speed** 40 ft.
**STR** 23 (+6) | **DEX** 9 (-1) | **CON** 21 (+5) | **INT** 9 (-1) | **WIS** 10 (+0) | **CHA** 12 (+1)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: CON](../proficiencies/saving-throw-con.md) +8, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +3, [Saving Throw: CHA](../proficiencies/saving-throw-cha.md) +4
**Skills:** [Skill: Athletics](../proficiencies/skill-athletics.md) +9, [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +3
**Damage Immunities:** cold
**Senses:** Passive Perception 13
**Languages:** Giant

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The giant makes two attacks, using Frost Axe or Great Bow in any combination.
- **Frost Axe.** Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.
- **Great Bow.** Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

## Bonus Actions
- **War Cry (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** The giant or one creature of its choice that can see or hear it gains 16 (2d10 + 5) Temporary Hit Points and has Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant’s next turn.
